posts.text: Heather McPherson, a Canadian Member of Parliament for the New Democratic Party (NDP), accused the Canadian government of applying double standards and failing to take concrete steps to uphold international law amid the ongoing genocide in the Gaza Strip. During a session in the Canadian House of Commons, McPherson pointed out that while the United States has imposed sanctions on the International Criminal Court (ICC) and a Canadian judge, and the United Kingdom has sanctioned companies involved in illegal Israeli settlements in the E1 area, Canada has failed to take any similar action.
